subject: Onboarding fee waiver & split-invoice cadence for Orchid Health
messages:
From: Marta Sanz <marta.sanz@orchidhealth.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@orchidhealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding fee + PO and invoicing questions

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the SOW — we reviewed and have a couple of procurement constraints before we can issue a PO. Two asks from our side:

1) Orchid requires invoices tied to a PO number; can you accept a single PO that references multiple monthly invoices (we prefer weekly/biweekly remittance windows) or do you need a separate PO per invoice?
2) We normally do Net45. Our procurement policy allows Net30 for platform vendors if there is an onboarding fee waiver. Would Redwood consider waiving the one-time onboarding fee (or rolling it into a staggered invoice) in exchange for Net30?

Also attaching our PO template for reference (we can send the official PO once terms are agreed). If helpful, we can jump on a quick call this afternoon.

Regards,
Marta
Marta Sanz
Senior Procurement Manager
Orchid Health

Attachments: PO-template.csv (text/csv)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Sanz <marta.sanz@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding fee + PO and invoicing questions

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear note and the template. Quick answers and next steps below: 

- PO handling: we can accept a single PO that maps to multiple invoices. Our billing system requires the PO number in the invoice header; we can emit weekly, biweekly, or monthly invoices against the single PO. If Orchid wants weekly remittance, we will split invoices by week and include the same PO number on each invoice.

- Net terms & onboarding fee: We typically list a one-time onboarding fee on the first invoice and default to Net45 for new enterprise customers. We're open to Net30 if we can make up for the smaller float via either: a) a partial onboarding fee that is amortized across the first 3 invoices, or b) a full waiver in exchange for a 6% prepay / commitment credit (applied as a one-time credit on invoice 1).

I’ve cc'd Vanessa (your AE) to confirm commercial flexibility and Ben (Finance) for billing mechanics. I'll follow up with a short proposal email that lists two concrete options so you can pick which works for procurement.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding fee + PO and invoicing questions

Adding context from commercial: Orchid is a mid-market health tech account — case for waiver: 12-month expected usage > $180k (projection), potential for Dedicated capacity next year. If we offer Net30 + waive onboarding fee, let's request a minimal commitment to protect AR and unit economics. Options I'm comfortable offering: 

Option A (preferred): Full onboarding fee waiver if Orchid signs a 12-month minimum commitment at the quoted SLAs (we can define $ threshold). Include a 1.5% annualized surcharge spread over first 3 invoices (internal accounting note).

Option B: Waive 50% of onboarding, amortize remainder across first 3 invoices; Redwood stays Net45 unless Orchid prepays 1 month upfront, which moves to Net30.

I'll let Ben confirm whether weekly invoice splits are OK operationally. If all good, Rachel — can you send a short commercial note with both options and a recommended default?

- Vanessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding fee + PO and invoicing questions

Finance confirms: we can issue multiple invoices against a single PO number. A few operational constraints to flag to Orchid procurement: 

- Each invoice must include: PO number, Redwood invoice number, billing entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.), and a line-item mapping to the SOW (we can include SOW reference code SOW-ORCH-11-26).
- Weekly invoices are okay but will increase AP overhead; suggest biweekly as the default to balance cash flow and effort.
- For the onboarding fee treatment: we can either put a one-line onboarding fee on invoice 1, or amortize it across invoices 1–3. If finance is asked to apply a waiver, we need an internal approval (written from Sales leadership).

If you decide on Option A or B, send the approval email and I'll flag for accounts receivable to allow Net30 instead of Net45 and to apply the requested credit/waiver.

-Ben
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Sanz <marta.sanz@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding fee + PO and invoicing questions

Hi Marta — here are two concrete proposals for procurement to choose from. We can put either option into the final SOW/amendment and route DocuSign once you confirm: 

Option 1 — Full waiver + 12m commitment (preferred):
- Onboarding fee: waived (no charge)
- Term: 12 months minimum at quoted rate; monthly usage billing continues
- Net terms: Net30
- Invoicing cadence: Biweekly invoices against a single PO number (we will include the PO on each invoice)
- Commercial offset: 1.5% commitment handling fee (applied as a line item across invoices 1–3)

Option 2 — Partial waiver, no term commitment:
- Onboarding fee: 50% waived; remaining 50% amortized across first 3 invoices
- Net terms: Net45 standard; Net30 if Orchid prepays one month at contract start
- Invoicing cadence: Biweekly or monthly per Orchid preference

Operational notes (Finance): Redwood will accept one PO for multiple invoices; each invoice must contain PO number and SOW reference SOW-ORCH-11-26.

Next steps: If either option works, reply with your preferred option and we’ll send a short amendment + DocuSign link. I’ve attached the latest SOW for reference.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SOW-Orchid-202611.pdf (application/pdf)
Related: DocuSign link will be provided in the amendment email.
